quote: A plan with no flaws is not a plan; it is destiny.
name: Baron Zemo — Helmut Zemo
notes: Mastermind tactician and 13th Baron Zemo, sworn to dismantle the Avengers with precision.

quote: The bill comes due. Always!
name: Baron Mordo — Karl Mordo
notes: Former disciple of the Ancient One turned dark sorcerer obsessed with stripping rivals of their magic.

quote: Every blow you land only makes me stronger, boy.
name: Sebastian Shaw — Black King
notes: Leader of the Inner Circle of Hellfire Club who metabolizes kinetic energy directly into physical power.

quote: I have fed on empires before your ancestors crawled from the mud.
name: Selene — Black Queen
notes: Ancient psychic vampire mutant who sustains her immortality by devouring the life-force of living beings.

quote: I don't want to cure cancer. I want to turn people into dinosaurs!
name: Sauron — Karl Lykos
notes: Genetic energy vampire who transforms into a humanoid pterosaur upon absorbing mutant life energy.

quote: My katana can cleave through any armor forged by human hands.
name: Silver Samurai — Kenuichio Harada
notes: Mutant warrior capable of charging tachyon energy through his katana to slice through any matter.

quote: I am Cable as he was meant to be—untouched by weakness!
name: Stryfe
notes: Cloned duplicate of Nathan Summers unburdened by the techno-organic virus, wielding immense psionic force.

quote: Your thoughts belong to Thanos now.
name: Supergiant
notes: Psionic parasite and Black Order general who feeds on intellect and enslaves minds.

quote: Kneel before the cosmic axe of Terrax!
name: Terrax the Tamer
notes: Brutal extraterrestrial tyrant endowed with the Power Cosmic and mastery over stone and planetary crusts.

quote: Nobody hits harder than Titania, and don't you forget it!
name: Titania — Mary MacPherran
notes: Superhumanly strong brawler who gained immense power from Doctor Doom during the original Secret Wars.

quote: Ribbit! Laugh now, heroes, before I spit venom in your eyes!
name: Toad — Mortimer Toynbee
notes: Agile mutant leaping combatant with prehensile tongue and caustic slime secretion.

quote: Mary is sweet. But Typhoid... Typhoid burns the world down.
name: Typhoid Mary — Mary Walker
notes: Mutant assassin afflicted with dissociative identity disorder, pyrokinesis, and telekinesis.

quote: Hydra has many heads, but I am the fang that delivers the venom.
name: Viper — Madame Hydra
notes: Ruthless supreme commander of Hydra skilled in poison mastery, martial arts, and global subversion.

quote: The surface dwellers will drown beneath Atlantean might!
name: Attuma
notes: Barbaric Atlantean warlord driven by prophecy to overthrow Namor and conquer the surface world.

quote: Ah, mon ami! You have yet to witness the perfection of French savate!
name: Batroc the Leaper
notes: World-class French mercenary and master of kickboxing savate, capable of superhuman acrobatics.

quote: Nothing moves the Blob! Absolutely nothing!
name: Blob — Fred Dukes
notes: Gargantuan mutant whose mass and gravitational anchoring render him virtually immovable.

quote: I don't need superpowers to put you in the ground, kid.
name: Crossbones — Brock Rumlow
notes: Sadistic Hydra mercenary, master brawler, and lethal marksman loyal to Red Skull.

quote: Father thinks he can atone. I just want to watch it all burn.
name: Daken — Akihiro
notes: Wolverine's estranged son possessing bone claws, healing factor, and emotional pheromone manipulation.

quote: *Humming disintegrator beam surges through enchanted Uru armor*
name: Destroyer
notes: Near-indestructible enchanted armor crafted by Odin to combat Celestials, possessing devastating beams.

quote: Blood is the life... and yours belongs to the Lord of Vampires.
name: Dracula — Lord of Vampires
notes: Ancient progenitor and supreme monarch of all vampires, wielding necromancy, weather control, and mist.

quote: Tremble, gnats of Earth! Fin Fang Foom has awakened!
name: Fin Fang Foom
notes: Gigantic shapeshifting dragon alien from planet Kakaranthara whose breath spews boiling acid mist.

quote: I am sound! Pure, deafening, omnipotent sound!
name: Klaw — Ulysses Klaw
notes: Physicist converted into a being of solid living sonic energy with a sound converter weapon claw.

quote: Asgard shall freeze until only ash and ice remain.
name: Laufey — King of Jotunheim
notes: Towering Frost Giant monarch of Jotunheim and biological father of Loki.

quote: Leech just wants to be left alone... but you lose your powers now.
name: Leech
notes: Gentle Morlock mutant with an involuntary damping field that completely negates nearby superpowers.

quote: I absorb cosmic radiation to become an unstoppable living colossus!
name: Living Monolith — Ahmet Abdol
notes: Mutant pharaoh who absorbs cosmic energy to swell into a colossal titanic powerhouse.

quote: They call me mad, yet my intellect dwarfs the entire Inhuman throne!
name: Maximus the Mad
notes: Genius Inhuman inventor and brother of Black Bolt with psionic mind-control and endless treachery.

quote: Ratings! Carnage! Give the viewers what they crave, you pathetic meatsacks!
name: Mojo
notes: Spine-less alien dictator of the Mojoverse who enslaves heroes for gladiatorial inter-dimensional TV ratings.

quote: The surface rejected me, but in Subterranea, I am absolute Emperor!
name: Mole Man — Harvey Elder
notes: First foe of the Fantastic Four, master of subterranean caverns and commander of colossal subterranean beasts.

quote: Arthur's realm has fallen, but my sorcery endures throughout eternity.
name: Morgan Le Fay
notes: Immortal high sorceress of Camelot and half-faerie, master of dark Netherworld mystical arts.

quote: Orka will crush surface dwellers like sea shells!
name: Orka
notes: Genetically altered Atlantean mutant bestowed with the proportional strength and bulk of a killer whale.

quote: A drop of our acid will dissolve both your skin and your hope.
name: Agony — Symbiote
notes: Purple symbiote spawned by the Life Foundation, spitting lethal metabolism-melting acid saliva.

quote: Whip and strike! The green tendrils tear everything apart!
name: Lasher — Symbiote
notes: Green symbiote spawn of Venom wielding segmented back tendrils as whip lashes and bladed projectiles.

quote: Universes die. Worlds collide. Such is the grand confession of existence.
name: Black Swan
notes: Mysterious survivor of an alternate Earth who joined Thanos's Black Order, wielding optic disintegrator beams.
